protocol.confirmatory_set: new held-out episodes (set = new); statements fixed beforehand in followup_checks/README.md
protocol.errors: mean over episodes of the per-episode 0.5 s forecast RMSE, [speed m/s, yaw rate rad/s]

parts.late: later than 1.5 s after the change

protocol.ratios: geometric mean over episodes; interval = 95% percentile bootstrap over episodes, GRU averaged over seeds; range_across_seeds = the same ratio for each training seed separately

protocol.source: learning.py model, loss, optimiser, windows and normalisation, unchanged
protocol.selection: epoch with the lowest validation loss

expectations.statement: After a motor fault the explicit estimator settles at a lower yaw-rate error than the GRU
expectations.measure: GRU error / explicit error, geometric mean over episodes, motor fault, later than 1.5 s, yaw rate

expectations.statement: For the fault to 0.25, outside the training faults, the gap is at least tenfold
expectations.measure: GRU error / explicit error, geometric mean over episodes, motor fault to 0.25, later than 1.5 s, yaw rate

expectations.statement: In the first 1.5 s after a motor fault the GRU has the lower yaw-rate error
expectations.measure: GRU error / explicit error, geometric mean over episodes, motor fault, first 1.5 s, yaw rate

expectations.statement: On low friction the GRU has the lower speed error
expectations.measure: GRU error / explicit error, geometric mean over episodes, low friction, later than 1.5 s, speed

expectations.statement: At friction 0.015 the explicit estimator settles at the lower speed error
expectations.measure: GRU error / explicit error, geometric mean over episodes, friction 0.015, later than 1.5 s, speed

expectations.statement: At friction 0.015 the GRU settles at the lower yaw-rate error
expectations.measure: GRU error / explicit error, geometric mean over episodes, friction 0.015, later than 1.5 s, yaw rate

expectations.statement: Without any change the explicit estimator is worse than the fixed model in yaw rate
expectations.measure: explicit error / fixed error, no change, all origins, yaw rate

expectations.statement: Without any change the GRU is worse than the explicit estimator in yaw rate
expectations.measure: GRU error / explicit error, geometric mean over episodes, no change, all origins, yaw rate

expectations.statement: The GRU latent state sits at its limits after the fault to 0.25 but not after faults like the training ones
expectations.measure: share of latent values beyond +-0.95 later than 1.5 s, mean over episodes and seeds
